metadata.name: ww-input-otp
metadata.description: A form-integrated one-time-password (OTP) input component for verification codes, PINs, and multi-character tokens. Renders a configurable number of single-character fields driven by a format string (e.g. 'xxxxxx', 'xxx-xxx', 'xx xx xx'), with optional separators, masking, and numeric or alphanumeric input modes.
features: Flexible format string: 'x' marks an input slot, any other character marks a separator position
Form container integration via fieldName with submission and validation support
Auto-focus of the first empty field on mount
Auto-submit of the parent form when all fields are filled
Automatic forward/backward navigation between fields on input and backspace
Paste handling that fills all fields from a single pasted string
Optional input masking with a custom mask character
Configurable separator rendered as a character or an icon
Exposes states: focus, readonly, disabled, error, complete
Does not support per-field labels or per-field styling
Does not support multi-line OTP layouts

properties.name: fieldName
properties.description: The field name used to identify this OTP input in form submissions. Required when the input is used inside a ww-form-container. Inactive when the element is not placed inside a form container.

inactiveProperty.description: Inactive when the element is not placed inside a form container (sidePanelContent.form?.uid is falsy).

properties.name: customValidation
properties.description: Enable a custom validation formula for this field. Only used inside a ww-form-container. Inactive when the element is not placed inside a form container.

inactiveProperty.description: Inactive when the element is not placed inside a form container (sidePanelContent.form?.uid is falsy).

properties.name: validation
properties.description: A formula expression used for custom validation logic. Only used when customValidation is enabled. Inactive when the element is not in a form container or when customValidation is false.

inactiveProperty.description: Inactive when the element is not placed inside a form container (sidePanelContent.form?.uid is falsy) or when customValidation is false.

properties.name: format
properties.description: Defines the OTP layout. Each 'x' (or 'X') represents a single-character input field; any other character represents a separator position. Examples: 'xxxxxx' (6 fields), 'xxx-xxx' (two groups of three separated by '-'), 'xx xx xx'.

properties.name: type
properties.description: The allowed character type. 'numeric' restricts input to digits 0-9 (and triggers numeric keyboards on mobile); 'alphanumeric' also allows letters a-z and A-Z.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Initial value for the OTP fields, trimmed to the number of slots defined by format. This is an init value only; read the current OTP through the exposed 'value' component variable, not through this prop.

properties.name: autoFocus
properties.description: Whether to automatically focus the first empty field when the component is mounted.

properties.name: autoSubmit
properties.description: Whether to automatically submit the surrounding ww-form-container when all fields are filled. Has no effect outside a form container.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Whether all fields must be filled for form validation to pass.

properties.name: readonly
properties.description: Whether the fields are read-only and cannot be edited by the user.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Whether the fields are disabled. Disabled inputs do not receive focus and are not included in form submission.

properties.name: gap
properties.description: Horizontal gap between input fields and separators. Accepts px values.

properties.name: fieldWidth
properties.description: Width of each input field. Accepts px or em values.

properties.name: fieldHeight
properties.description: Height of each input field. Accepts px or em values.

properties.name: borderRadius
properties.description: Corner radius of each input field.

properties.name: borderWidth
properties.description: Border thickness of each input field.

properties.name: borderColor
properties.description: Default border color of each input field.

properties.name: borderColorFocus
properties.description: Border color applied to the currently focused field.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: Background color of each input field.

properties.name: textAlign
properties.description: Horizontal alignment of the character inside each field.

properties.name: fontFamily
properties.description: Font family used for the characters typed into the fields.

properties.name: fontSize
properties.description: Font size of the characters inside the fields.

properties.name: fontWeight
properties.description: Font weight of the characters inside the fields. Pass null for the default weight.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Text color of the characters inside the fields.

properties.name: placeholderChar
properties.description: Single character displayed inside empty fields when displayPlaceholder is true. Inactive when displayPlaceholder is false.

properties.name: placeholderColor
properties.description: Color of the placeholder character inside empty fields. Inactive when displayPlaceholder is false.

properties.name: maskInput
properties.description: Whether to hide typed characters and render the mask character instead. The real value remains available through the 'value' component variable.

properties.name: maskCharacter
properties.description: Single character rendered in place of the typed character when maskInput is true. Inactive when maskInput is false.

properties.name: maskColor
properties.description: Color of the mask character when maskInput is true. Inactive when maskInput is false.

properties.name: displayPlaceholder
properties.description: Whether to render the placeholder character in empty fields.

properties.name: separatorType
properties.description: Type of separator rendered at non-'x' positions in the format string. When set to 'none', separator-related style properties are ignored and no separator is rendered.

properties.name: separatorChar
properties.description: Character used as separator when separatorType is 'character'. If empty, the character from the format string at the separator position is used. Inactive when separatorType is not 'character'.

properties.name: separatorIcon
properties.description: Icon name used as separator when separatorType is 'icon'. Uses the wwLib icon set (e.g. 'lucide/separator-vertical'). Inactive when separatorType is not 'icon'.

properties.name: separatorColor
properties.description: Color of the separator character or icon. Inactive when separatorType is 'none'.

properties.name: separatorSize
properties.description: Font size of the separator character or icon. Inactive when separatorType is 'none'.

states.name: focus
states.description: Active while any field is currently focused.

states.name: readonly
states.description: Active when the readonly property is true.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Active when the disabled property is true.

states.name: error
states.description: Active when the current value fails validation (required check or custom validation formula).

states.name: complete
states.description: Active when every field is filled.

events.name: change
events.description: Triggered whenever the OTP value changes, including on individual character input, backspace, paste, and programmatic setValue calls.

events.name: complete
events.description: Triggered when every field has been filled (fires once the last empty field receives a character).

events.name: focus
events.description: Triggered when any field receives focus from user interaction (not emitted when focus is moved programmatically between fields).

events.name: blur
events.description: Triggered when focus leaves the OTP component entirely (not when moving between its own fields).

events.name: clear
events.description: Triggered when the clear action is invoked, resetting all fields to empty.

localContext.description: Local context object exposing the current OTP state. Useful for binding to the current value, validity, or completeness directly inside the component's subtree.

actions.label: Focus first field
actions.description: Focus the first empty field, or the first field if all are filled.

actions.label: Clear all fields
actions.description: Clear every field and reset the value to an empty string.

actions.label: Set value
actions.description: Programmatically set the OTP value. The value is trimmed to the number of input slots defined by format.

variables.name: value
variables.description: The current raw OTP value without separators (e.g. '123456'). Updated on every input, backspace, paste, clear, and setValue call.

variables.name: formattedValue
variables.description: The current OTP value with separators inserted according to the format string (e.g. '123-456' for format 'xxx-xxx'). Read-only.

specifications: When used as a form input, place this element inside a ww-form-container and set a meaningful fieldName. The form container collects the current raw value automatically.
The number of input fields is derived from the number of 'x' (or 'X') characters in the format string. Any other character in format is a separator position.
Do not attempt to bind to the 'value' property to read the user's input; it is only an init value. Read the current OTP via the 'value' component variable or the 'otp-input.value' local context path.
When separatorType is 'none', the separatorChar, separatorIcon, separatorColor, and separatorSize properties have no visual effect.
When maskInput is true, typed characters are visually replaced with maskCharacter but the real value is still exposed via the 'value' variable and submitted to the form.
autoSubmit has no effect outside a ww-form-container; setting it to true on a standalone OTP input does nothing.
The element exposes the 'complete' state when every slot is filled; use this state for conditional styling (e.g. success border) rather than binding a workflow to it.
